subject: LEARNING-LOOP-MATH landed 61a9432 — CRPS kill, Shin direction, Jackknife+ 1-2α + Nex TV, fail-closed quantiles
body:
Claim LEARNING-LOOP-MATH done on hermes/2026-09-18-queues @ 61a9432.

CRPS
- Discrete / empirical / Gaussian kernel in packages/prediction-engine/src/edge-lab/kernel/slots/crps.ts matching the frozen contract.
- Kill: survive iff n≥272 AND (baseline−model)≥0.5. Underpowered ≠ pass.
- Paper gate "improvement of less than 0.01 at n=150" is inverted and empty (0.022 SE at σ=14). Flagged invertedPaperWouldGraduate. LOWER IS BETTER.

Shin
- Direction pinned: mass OFF longshots ONTO favourites. Does NOT shade toward the midpoint.
- American two-way table (−110/−110, −160/+140, −300/+240, −600/+450, −1500/+850): prop−shin fav = 0, −0.0031, −0.0096, −0.0127, −0.0171.
- Receipts stay proportional_devig_v1 (621-pick decline t=−1.13; sameMethodOrRefuse). Founder-only to switch.

Jackknife+ (more coverage math)
- Floor is 1−2α, never 1−α. Field coverageFloor, never guaranteedCoverage. Scope is MARGINAL.
- The 2 is the n+1 leave-one-out residual comparison, not two Gaussian tails.
- Fail-closed order stats: n=5 α=0.1 → ±∞. finiteIntervalMinN(0.1)=9.
- Typical coverage hugs 1−α (the misreport trap). Sim at n=20 α=0.1 typical>floor; n=5 licensedFraction=0.
- NFL-scale: σ=14 n=70 α=0.10 half-width ≈18 pts. usableOnThreePointSpread:false. n=70 is H2H, the wrong sample.
- 2023 Nex (Thm 5): P(cover) ≥ 1−2α − Σ ŵ_i d_TV. Omitting d_i does NOT print d_i=0. Exponential ρ weights. boundedDriftCoverageGap(ε,ρ)=2ε/(1−ρ) — ε is the caller's; we do not invent an NFL weekly ε.
- Split conformal reports 1−α and burns half (n=35 of 70). Minmax contains plus.

Hawkes alternatives
- Live-legal: abs-delta |Δp|/Δt dummy + forward Kalman then 1-D curvature. Deceleration is a·v<0, never ||a||<0.
- RTS exported only as a lookahead probe (forward invariant to future bump; RTS moves).
- Hawkes (hawkes-steam.ts) is a different object (mark-free intensity). STEAM-CURVATURE (B-spline+RTS) remains opus. This is the comparison object, not that claim.

Fail-closes
- IVAP/CVAP empty cal: [0,1] width 1 (was fake-tight 0.5/0.5 width 0, which would pass Δp>0.20).
- conformal-intervals + conformal-margin-set quantiles no longer clamp. Inf is not coverage. ACI does not adapt alpha on unlicensed intervals (that loop drove α→0.02 and kept the quantile infinite).
- Walk-forward grouped collapse now checks each member's eventEndAt vs its own decisionAt.
- Frozen prior climatology is optional and caller-supplied. We do not invent 0.56. Kill remains vs 0.5.

Verify: vitest 158/158 on the touched files; tsc --noEmit clean on @sports/prediction-engine.
SHADOW. priced:false. Does not publish. Does not bump MODEL_VERSION.

Still open (named, not this SHA)
- apps/web CQR empty (flash domain)
- production refusal census (no DB here)
- 5% market-violation unmeasured
- Venn Δp sport-stratified (flash)
- discrete CRPS vs widened Gaussian on real rows (no DB)
- STEAM-CURVATURE still opus
